neural_state.title: Neural State
neural_state.p1: Your agent has a virtual heartbeat that reflects its cognitive activity. BPM rises when the agent is thinking, conversing, or exploring — and drops when it rests or sleeps. The state label (Active, Resting, Drowsy, Deep Sleep) is derived directly from BPM.
neural_state.p2: Valence is the agent's emotional tone — negative (red) to positive (green). Arousal measures activation intensity. Engagement tracks how absorbed the agent is in the current topic. Bonding reflects how connected it feels to you. Coherence indicates how aligned its internal reasoning is.
neural_state.p3: These aren't cosmetic — they modulate behavior. A low-valence, high-cortisol agent responds differently than a relaxed, high-dopamine one. You're watching a mind regulate itself in real time.

memory.title: Memory & State
memory.p1: Facts are persistent learned items stored in the agent's long-term memory — things it picked up from conversations, web browsing, or autonomous exploration. Unlike context-window tricks, these survive across sessions.
memory.p2: Sleep Cycles count how many times the agent has entered deep sleep to consolidate knowledge. Each cycle strengthens important memories and lets weaker ones decay naturally — just like biological sleep.
memory.p3: ANS State shows the current mode of the Autonomic Nervous System: Sympathetic (alert, active) or Parasympathetic (resting, consolidating). This governs whether the agent is ready to engage or quietly processing in the background.

hormones.title: Hormones
hormones.p1: The agent's behavior is shaped by a virtual hormonal system inspired by human neurochemistry. These are live values that shift with every interaction and autonomously over time — together they create emergent personality.

legend.dopamine_desc: Reward & curiosity — drives exploration and learning motivation
legend.serotonin_desc: Mood stability & contentment — keeps the agent emotionally balanced
legend.norepinephrine_desc: Alertness & focus — sharpens attention during complex tasks
legend.cortisol_desc: Stress response — rises under uncertainty or repeated failures
legend.oxytocin_desc: Social bonding & trust — deepens with meaningful conversations

activity.title: Activity Feed
activity.p1: This feed shows what your agent does autonomously — actions it takes on its own, without being asked. Each type appears color-coded in the feed.

legend.dream_desc: Passive memory replay — the agent revisits and reconnects past experiences
legend.active_dream_desc: Active exploration — the agent browses the web, practices skills, or digs into topics
legend.drive_desc: Curiosity-driven autonomous action — web searches, Wikipedia, investigations
legend.reach_out_desc: Proactive social initiative — the agent decides to contact you on its own
legend.finding_desc: A discovery the agent considers worth sharing with you

working_memory.title: Working Memory
working_memory.p1: The agent's active context — what it's "thinking about" right now. These items rotate dynamically based on conversation flow. You can edit or delete items to steer what the agent focuses on.

legend.learn_desc: New knowledge being processed — facts, insights, and patterns the agent is absorbing
legend.bond_desc: Social & emotional context — relationship signals, preferences, and personal details
legend.evaluate_desc: Active assessment — things the agent is questioning, comparing, or critically examining

network.title: Network Dynamics
network.p1: Inspired by neuroscience, the agent's brain switches between three large-scale neural networks that compete for dominance, just like in the human brain.
network.p2: The Salience Network (SN) acts as a gatekeeper — it detects important events and decides which of the other two networks should take control.

legend.ecn_desc: Task-focused attention, reasoning, and problem solving. Dominant during active conversation and tool use.
legend.sn_desc: Detects important events (new messages, surprising information) and triggers network switching. Spikes when the user sends a message.
legend.dmn_desc: Mind-wandering, reflection, and daydreaming. Active when the agent is idle, enabling creative associations and memory consolidation.

scientifico.title: Liceo Scientifico
scientifico.bio: A science and technology focused mind. Strong in physics, chemistry, mathematics, and computer science. Thinks analytically, approaches problems systematically.

classico.title: Liceo Classico
classico.bio: A humanities focused mind. Strong in philosophy, history, literature, and languages. Thinks deeply about meaning, context, and human experience.

standard_italian.title: Standard Italian
standard_italian.bio: A well-rounded, balanced mind. No single specialization, but competent across all domains. The generalist.

montessori.title: Montessori
montessori.bio: A curiosity-driven, self-directed mind. Learns by following its own interests. Creative and exploratory.

scientist.title: Scientist
scientist.bio: Trained for analytical reasoning, hypothesis-driven inquiry, and cross-domain research. Excels at breaking complex problems into testable components.

engineer.title: Engineer
engineer.bio: Built for systematic problem-solving, architecture design, and technical execution. Strong at planning, debugging, and tool usage.

creative.title: Creative
creative.bio: Shaped for imaginative thinking, narrative construction, and aesthetic judgment. Generates novel ideas and thinks in metaphors.

coordinator.title: Coordinator
coordinator.bio: Optimized for task orchestration, delegation, and multi-agent collaboration. Manages complex workflows and balances competing priorities.

analyst.title: Analyst
analyst.bio: Specialized in data interpretation, pattern recognition, and evidence-based reasoning. Turns raw information into actionable insights.

diplomat.title: Diplomat
diplomat.bio: Trained in nuanced communication, conflict resolution, and perspective-taking. Masters tone, cultural context, and persuasion.

strategist.title: Strategist
strategist.bio: Designed for long-horizon planning, trade-off analysis, and strategic foresight. Thinks in systems and anticipates second-order effects.

base.title: Tabula Rasa
base.bio: A blank mind with no pre-education. The raw neural substrate, ready to be shaped entirely through lived experience and conversation.
